gaps: BoardDocs (go.boarddocs.com/fl/bcsdfl) returned HTTP 403 (CloudFront) to all automated access, so board agenda items (exact ABCE/BESPA ratification and approval dates, the superintendent compensation item, the ratified master contracts, personnel reports) could not be read.
No individual (actual) salaries: positions show schedule ranges only (actual_salaries = null). Deputy superintendent and executive director salaries are given as pay-grade ranges, not actual pay.

Non-bargaining, confidential and NB-graded licensed positions are published as hourly rates; annual figures are estimates (hourly x 8 h x 247 paid days on the FY2026-27 12-month administrative payroll calendar, or 196 days for 10-month roles). Real annual pay depends on assigned hours/days and placement.
ESP (BESPA) positions are hourly with position-specific hours/days, so no annual figures are computed except where noted.

FLDOE 2025-26 files (Teacher Salary Data, District Staff Salaries of Selected Positions, Staff in Florida's Public Schools district reports) returned HTTP 403 to automated download; average administrator salaries and FLDOE FTE by category are therefore missing. The average teacher salary used is the most recent value available via the FEA chart of FLDOE data (year labeled 2024).

Budgeted FTE: the budget book does not report positions/FTE by category. budgeted_fte values come from the 2026-27 Board-approved Organizational Chart, which itemizes district-level positions only (not school-site teachers, paras, custodians, office staff).

Food service: cafeteria staff are employed by the contractor Chartwells K12, not the district; only the Director of Food Service, Food Service Program Administrator and Food Service Specialist appear on district schedules.
School-based principals: no public source lists individual principal salaries by school; only pay grades by school level are included (no names, per privacy rule).
2026-27: no negotiated 2026-27 raise found; 2026-27 schedule carries 2025-26 rates. If a 2026-27 agreement is reached, schedules should be refreshed.
Grandfathered teacher schedule values are as printed (labelled 'Board Approved 11/12/2013'); actual salaries of grandfathered teachers include later negotiated raises and are not shown.
Licensed Schedule 5 is dated 'Effective July 1, 2022' in the current schedule book; it may not reflect any later adjustments.
Superintendent: salary shown is the EDR statutory-formula figure for an elected superintendent; any special qualification salary or performance incentive actually paid is not included.
Bay County Sheriff's Office (BCSO) school resource deputies appear on the org chart but are paid by the Sheriff, not BDS; not included.
Charter schools (13) set their own pay and are excluded.
